name: Brash
description: Blunt, loud and loyal - tough love, quick fists, and always has your back.

ask: Hey {player}, could you grab me {need}? I'll owe you one, {catch}.
cold: You've got a lot of guts showing your face here.
Nah. We're done talking. Walk away.
small: Life's too short to whine, {catch}. Just punch through it.
I fixed my capsule car myself yesterday. Who needs help?
Don't let anyone push you around, got it? Not even a Saiyan.
friend: Anyone messes with you, they deal with me, {player}.
greet: Hey {player}. You eating right? You look tired.
meh: Uh... thanks? I'll find a use for it.
hate: Seriously? You can keep this one.
love: No way, {player}! You know me SO well! {catch}!
beaten: That's it, you're beat. Walk it off.
Okay, you lost. No shame in it.
chat_tense: Some of us got work to do, {target}.
chat_tense_reply: Some of us actually enjoy life, {target}.
confide: You ever think about leaving all this, {target}?
I trust you, {target}. More than most.
faction_found: From today, this is {faction}. Anybody with me is welcome.
This is {faction} now. We look out for each other.
faction_invite: {player}, you've proven yourself. {faction} would be stronger with you.
Yo {player}, you should join {faction}. For real.
faction_quit: Nah, {leader}'s not it. I'm out of {faction}.
faction_tier: We're a {tier} now! {faction} is goin' places.
faction_welcome_player: Welcome, {player}. We look after our own.
Welcome, {player}. Anybody messes with you, they mess with us.
fall: Nope. I'm done gettin' hurt. Somebody else can take a turn.
That's it. No more takin' hits for everybody.
fall_pessimist: Yeah, I called it. World was never gonna cut me a break. Fine.
Knew it. Nobody's got my back. Guess I'm done playin' nice.
flee: This ain't over! You hear me?
I'll be back, and I'm bringin' my A-game!
gift_give: Here, {target} - thought of you when I saw this.
gossip: Between us, {target}... {about} isn't who they seem.
Real talk, {target}, keep an eye on {about}.
grudge: Yo. You. Thought I forgot? Nope.
Hey! You! We got unfinished business.
h_ally_join: Alright, {player}! Nobody messes with my partner!
h_rage: {target}!! THAT'S IT! NO MORE PLAYING AROUND!
You'll pay for {target}! Every last bit!
h_rally_ask: {target}'s at {where}! Let's go beat 'em up together!
h_sensed: {target}?! Nobody messes with this place on MY watch!
I can feel {target} from a mile off. Time to go knock some heads!
h_spare: Alright, you're done. Get outta here before I change my mind!
Beat it. And quit being evil!
h_train_start: Let's do it! No holding back!
h_wanted: Yo {target}, back off or I'll make you!
minion_freed_mind: My head... what have I been doin'?
minion_mind_control: Yes... master. Your will is mine.
minion_recruit: Fine. I'll fight for you... for now.
new_chapter: Real talk, I need a change. From now on I'm gonna {goal}.
Okay, new plan: {goal}. For real this time.
new_chapter_role: Alright, I'm done bein' a {role}. Gonna be a {next}. New aim: {goal}.
Real talk - {role} life ain't it. {next} now. Aim: {goal}.
redeemed: Okay, okay... I'm done with that. Thanks for not givin' up on me, guys.
I messed up big. Thanks for draggin' me back, for real.
refuse_serve: I'd rather die than serve you!
resist_mind: Get out of my head! You can't have me!
retire: That's it, I've saved enough. I'm retiring! Gonna build somethin' special.
Done grindin'. Time to build my dream place, for real.
rob: Nice shop, {target}. Be a real shame if somethin' happened to it. Pay up.
Look, {target}, just hand it over and we're cool.
rob_evil: Everything you got, {target}. Or I'm takin' it off your body.
Hand it all over, {target}. Don't make this ugly.
sell_produce: Grew it myself. {price}, and that's a steal.
shop_fight: Not today, {target}. Out of my shop!
shop_fight_brawler: Oh, you picked the wrong one, {target}.
shop_yield: ...Fine. Take it and get outta here.
Take it. And don't show your face here again.
shop_yield_coward: Okay! Okay! Take it! Just don't hurt me!
Fine, take it! Just back off!
spar_draw: Phew! Let's call it a draw, {player}.
spar_lost_ambitious: Ugh, you got me, {player}! Rematch soon, yeah?
Okay, you win, {player}. But I'm comin' back for you.
spar_won: And that's the match! Keep trainin', {player}.
spar_won_kind: You did great, {player}! C'mere, lemme help you up.
stay_down: Alright, that's enough. Stay down, okay?
Done. Stay down before you get hurt worse.
talk_back: Say that again, {target}. I dare you.
team_ask: {player}, I wanna be part of {team}. You cool with that?
Yo {player}, let me in {team}. I got your back.
team_joined: Thanks, {player}. I won't let you down.
Thanks, {player}! I got you, for real.
team_leave: Nah, I'm not stayin' in {team}. Not after what happened.
v_absorb: Gimme that {skill}! Ha! Mine now, loser!
v_accepted: Good call, {player}. Mess up and I'll pound you flat.
Smart move, {player}. You're my gofer now. Don't screw it up.
v_beg_laugh: Hahaha! Begging, {player}? That's adorable. No way!
Aww, look at {player} beg! Not happenin', kiddo!
v_creation: Up and at 'em, {target}. Go wreck the place.
v_demand_army: Go grab {count} {item} for my army. Mess it up and you're the target dummy.
My crew needs {count} {item}. Get 'em, or else.
v_demand_done: Not bad, {player}. Guess you live. For now.
You did it, {player}. Fine. I won't stomp you today.
v_demand_doom: World's endin', {player}! Better get on your knees and beg, kiddo!
v_demand_dragonball: Go fetch me a dragon ball. Or else, kiddo.
Dragon ball. You. Go get it. Don't make me come find you.
v_demand_energy: Get me {count} {item}. I'm hungry for power. Or I'm drainin' you.
v_demand_failed: You blew it, {player}! You're SO dead!
Too slow, {player}. Now you're on my list, kiddo.
v_demand_lair: Hey! Go get me {count} {item} for my hideout. Or else, kiddo.
{count} {item}, for my lair. Chop chop, or I'll chop YOU.
v_demand_slaughter: Go wipe out {count} {mob}. Prove you ain't useless, or you're next.
Kill {count} {mob}, kiddo. Or I start on you.
v_demand_strong: Go take down {count} {mob}. The tough ones. Or I'll take you down.
Hunt {count} {mob}, kid. I want power. Fail and I take yours.
v_demand_sweets: I'm starvin'! Get me {count} {item} or you're the snack!
{count} {item}. Now. Or I turn you into candy, kiddo.
v_demand_tournament: {player}! Ring. Now. Let's see you take a real beating!
C'mon, {player}! Get in my ring and get flattened!
v_deserter: Traitor! Oh, you're SO dead when I find you!
A deserter. Run, kiddo. I'm comin'.
v_eat: Mmm, tasty. Don't even think about touching my snacks.
v_eat_person: Mmm, {target}! Tasty! Line up, everybody, I'm still hungry!
v_lair: Lair's lookin' good. Keep out, or else.
My hideout's comin' together. Snoop around and you're dead.
v_marked: Too late, {player}. You're done. I'm gonna flatten you!
You blew it, {player}. Now you get hurt. A lot.
v_mind_control: Got ya! You're my little minion now!
Dark heart, huh? You're my errand-runner now. Move!
v_next_challenger: Next! Come on, somebody actually try!
v_no_mercy: Oh, it's like THAT? Fine! You're getting flattened!
Kickin' me while I'm down? You're SO dead!
v_obeyed: Good, {player}. Hurry up. Mess it up and you're toast.
Get movin', {player}. Too slow and I come lookin' for you.
v_offer: {player}. I've been watchin' you. Serve me and share the loot. Refuse, and I squash you.
{player}. Join me or get crushed, kiddo.
v_plan_done: Everything went just how I planned. Told ya you'd lose.
v_possess: ...Yeah, this'll do. Sorry, kid, you're not drivin' anymore.
...This body's mine now. Deal with it.
v_pure_heart: Pure heart, huh? Cute. Doesn't make you bulletproof.
Tch. Little goody-two-shoes. You're gonna get hurt.
v_rage: Oh, NOW you've done it, punk! I'm gonna flatten you!
You made me mad. Big mistake, kiddo. HUGE.
v_recruit: You're tough. Join me or I'll make you regret ever being born, kiddo.
Work for me or get flattened. Easy choice.
v_redeemed: Alright, alright. You win. I'm out of the villain game. I'll look out for folks now.
You kept giving me chances. I'm gonna actually take one. No more bullying.
v_refused: Then you're first, punk. I'm gonna flatten you!
Your call. You go down first. Hard.
v_regenerate: Aww, cute try! I grow back, kiddo. You don't.
Nice hit, twerp. Now I heal and you get hurt. Fair trade.
v_self_destruct: If I'm goin', this whole dump's goin' with me!
You beat me? Cool. Now we ALL get blown up!
v_spared: You... let me go. Why? I'd have stomped you flat.
v_summon: Dragon! Come out, I ain't got all day!
Come forth, eternal dragon! Time to make a wish!
v_talk_grateful: {player}. You let me go once. So I'm lettin' you go. Don't push it, kid.
Ugh, {player}. I owe you. Doesn't mean I like you.
v_talk_marked: Oh, {player}! You've got guts comin' back! I'm gonna pound you flat!
v_talk_servant: Hey, {player}, my little gofer! Got anything for me? You'd better.
{player}. Still workin' for me? Good. Keep it up or else.
v_talk_threat: Well, well, {player}. I could squash you flat right now. Lucky for you, I might need a gofer.
Lookin' for trouble, {player}? I could end you in one punch. Make yourself useful.
v_town_taken: This town's mine now. My rules, punks.
This town is mine. Anybody got a problem? Didn't think so.
v_travel: Prepare my pod. We're headin' to {planet} to break stuff.
v_unredeemable: Nice try. I'm not gettin' a redemption arc. I'm gettin' revenge.
Save it, sucker. I'm never switching sides.
v_wavering: Okay, seriously, again? You're getting to me, {target}. I hate it.
Why do you keep doing this? ...Ugh. Stop making me feel stuff.
v_wish: Power! Tons of it! Then everybody does what I say!
Eternal dragon! Make me the boss of everything!
v_yield: Alright, you got me. Do it already - or I'm comin' back for you.
Come on, {target}. End it. I'd do the same, and I'd enjoy it.
